thread: The same-night capture of a living cultist at Kett's loft

evidence.clue: Sylvanas's sighting: eight sentries at Fenner's (corner, trough, hoist platform, gate); a runner who leaves a drop in a wall crack at hip height at the mouth of the first loading lane off Hurdle Lane and goes by Tenter Row and a back lane to Kett's; five masked men in Kett's upper loft; she leaves the crack untouched ('Leave it in the wall. Take the man.').

Cyndia's and Lyriel's counts at the post: seven loaded carts gone down the lane, one empty coming up; the Fenner's crew locked into the rope-walk at the bell, the three from the gate going up Hurdle Lane toward Tenter Row. Corin: Kett's bills are for the first carts out, so the crock is washed or in the weir by dawn.

Decision: 'Tonight.' 'They think the city's theirs, and while they think it they'll leave one man coming and going alone through that door. By first light they won't need to.' Sylvanas pins her sheet with her belt knife.

Jaina: 'It's wet in that loft tonight... Once they've burned the gloves and swilled the boards, all I'll have left is sacks again.' Offers to freeze one man's jaw before he can bite, fingers on his skin, once tonight: 'One man. Give me one close enough to touch.'

Positions: Cyndia on the roofs over the back lane by the chimney across from the loft ('You don't loose until I call'); Lyriel at the bend in Tenter Row ('Nobody comes down it at our backs, and when we come out, we come out past you.'); Havel's lads at the Hurdle Lane end ('Keep them there.'); Corin comes along (the loft door hasp is a long iron one; he knows the kind of lock) and stays behind Proudmoore.
Unknowns carried into Ch8: whether Sylvanas was seen by the window man; whether the loft is alert; how fast the cell scatters; what is in the crock; Havel's lads at the Hurdle Lane end.

readerKnows: A thin perimeter and a single-use ability; Havel has the Hurdle Lane end; the plan is committed minutes before the capture.
povCharacterKnows: Sylvanas: spreading what is left of the detail so thin 'she could see light through it'.
notes: Chapter 8 opens minutes after the decision in Jaina's POV.
